title: ENSO Diagnostic Discussion (issued 10 September 2026)
key_claim: NOAA's September 2026 discussion keeps an El Niño Advisory in force and gives a greater than 90% chance of a very strong event in the Northern Hemisphere fall and winter 2026-27.
frame_summary: NOAA argues the 2026-27 El Niño is strengthening toward a very strong, possibly historic, event, a physical forecast that carries no judgement on food markets.
verbatim_quote: El Niño is strengthening, with a greater than 90% chance of a very strong event during the Northern Hemisphere fall and winter 2026-27.
verbatim_list: sea surface temperature anomalies exceeding +3.0°C in the eastern equatorial Pacific
notes: Fetched via WebFetch 2026-10-06; issue date line reads 10 September 2026. Quote re-checked by hand on the live page text. The page is a rolling product, so the live page may later show a newer issue; the quoted text is the 10 September 2026 issue.

title: FAO Food Price Index (September 2026 release)
key_claim: The FAO Cereal Price Index averaged 122.8 points in September with wheat at its highest level since August 2023; the Vegetable Oil Price Index averaged 198.6 points and stood 18.3% above a year earlier.
frame_summary: FAO argues that September's index rise was led by cereals and sugar on supply worries, with vegetable oils still far above their level a year earlier.
verbatim_quote: The FAO Cereal Price Index averaged 122.8 points in September
verbatim_list: 18.3 percent above its level a year earlier
notes: Fetched via WebFetch 2026-10-06. The source writes percentages as 'percent'; the body restates as 18.3% under house style. Rolling page: the September release may be replaced by a newer month.

title: Central teams to visit Karnataka and Maharashtra to assess drought situation
key_claim: At the National Agriculture Conference for Rabi Campaign 2026 the Union agriculture minister asked states for crop plans based on water availability and soil moisture, promoted pulses and oilseeds on land fallow after paddy, and said nearly two-thirds of Maharashtra is affected by drought.
frame_summary: The government's own account presents the rabi plan as drawn from water availability and soil moisture, with pulses and oilseeds steered onto post-paddy fallow.
verbatim_quote: Maharashtra, Karnataka, Telangana and Andhra Pradesh would need crop plans based on water availability and soil moisture.
verbatim_list: Mr Chouhan urged states to promote pulses and oilseeds, particularly in areas that remain fallow after paddy cultivation.
two-thirds of Maharashtra has been affected and the State has declared drought
notes: Classified Tier 1 as the public broadcaster's report of a Union minister's statement (primary government position); it is not a ministry press release, and no Hindi or English PIB release for the 28-29 September conference could be located. Fetched 2026-10-06.

title: Semiannual Fertilizer Outlook: tensions in the Middle East trigger disruptions in the fertilizer market

frame_summary: Rabobank argues that markets remain well supplied by historically high inventories, so El Niño and input-cost risks push prices only toward the top of recent trading ranges.
verbatim_quote: inventories remain historically high, keeping prices within established ranges
verbatim_list: risks from El Niño, rising input costs, and Black Sea export challenges may increase uncertainty and support prices near the upper end of recent trading ranges over the next six to twelve months

title: When risks stack up: Threats to global food markets in 2026
date_evidence: John Baffes, Dawit Mekonnen, Kaltrina Temaj June 16, 2026
key_claim: The World Bank warns that El Niño, dear fertiliser and biofuel demand are stacking up as food-market risks, and that during the food price crises of 2008 and 2022 successive export bans on grains and edible oils amplified global price spikes.
frame_summary: The World Bank argues that El Niño, dear fertiliser and biofuel demand stack up as risks to food prices, and that export bans have turned past price spikes into crises.
verbatim_quote: During the food price crises of 2008 and 2022, successive export bans on grains and edible oils amplified global price spikes
notes: Structural anchor (3-6 month band), about 3.7 months before the scan date; canonical for the export-ban transmission channel. Fetched 2026-10-06.

title: India sets lower food production target for 2026-27 as El Niño clouds Rabi season
key_claim: India cut its 2026-27 foodgrain target to 373.93 million tonnes, with a rabi target of 177.72 million tonnes set from reservoir water and soil moisture; IIT Gandhinagar's India Drought Monitor put 52.5% of the country's area under dry or drought conditions on 16 September, up from 38.9% a month earlier.
frame_summary: Down to Earth argues the target reduction reflects a drought that has spread fast, with the dry and drought area up sharply within a month.
verbatim_quote: around 52.5 per cent of the country's area was under dry or drought conditions as of September 16, up sharply from 38.9 per cent about a month earlier
verbatim_list: The targets have been determined by considering real time situations and taking into account factors such as water availability in reservoirs, soil moisture conditions
notes: Reports the Drought Monitor figure and the ministry's target; 373.93 and 177.72 are also in the Hindi ETV Bharat source. Fetched 2026-10-06.
